blocks_element.repere: Paragraphe · A quick search of the active ingredient
blocks_element.text: A quick search of the active ingredient of the product reviewed here, Pharmaceutical Grade Methylene Blue, reveals first that it is a synthetic dye used in industry, and what is apposite when consumed, has been discovered to “hold immense promise in revolutionizing the treatment of many diseases,” as well as possessing an extraordinary range of therapeutic values. Rather than a supplement, Methylene Blue is medicinal in character with few serious side effects.The list of restorative benefits attributed to pharmaceutical grade Methylene Blue is astonishing. To name just a few, they include anti-depressant and anti-inflammatory effects, slowing or even stopping Alzheimer’s and Parkinson’s diseases by reducing the toxic proteins in the brain, diabetes treatment and anti-viral properties. And this is just a fraction of the conditions that may be improved or cured with methylene blue.As for the seller’s assertions that Methylene Blue improves brain function, focus and cellular vitality, those effects are usually too subtle to accurately discern. But I have no reason to dispute them either given the broad range of efficacy ascribed to Methylene Blue. Nutrical also includes Vitamin C as a constituent to Methylene Blue. Vitamin C is an essential vitamin that the body does not produce naturally and is found in a variety of foods, or is taken as a supplement; besides an antioxidant, it is known to aid in the absorption of minerals in the body.Although I have not thus far felt compelled to cover my office walls with dry erase board and tackle difficult differential equations or the daunting task of finding the next largest prime number, there is one harmless effect when consuming methylene blue that is not subtle and won’t be overlook by the user: discharged urine can be a greenish-blue (cyan) color; the printed information on the Nutricel bottle makes note that this is normal and to be expected. Besides, it’s a nice color.I’ve been a user of Methylene Blue, on and off, for some time now and believe that it may have the effect of improving my short-term memory. This is noticeable in remembering, for example, longer strings of contiguous numbers.I rated the product 5-Stars because I take no issue with the sellers’ contentions.
